claims.label: PRIMARY-SOURCE DEFINITION
claims.statement: A source-defined t-embedding uses Euclidean dual-edge lengths as geometric edge weights and requires them to be gauge-equivalent to the graph weights with boundary gauge fixed to one.

claims.label: EXACT IDENTIFIABILITY CONSEQUENCE
claims.statement: For a true source-defined t-embedding, the full graph-weight gauge class, hence all eight WP01 quotient coordinates, is determined by embedding geometry through the Euclidean length class.

claims.label: NUMERICAL CONFORMANCE FAILURE
claims.statement: The five retained generated C05 branches do not reproduce the protected C04 quotient under Euclidean geometric edge weights; the simplest P12 invariant is 0.01184–0.02240 instead of 1.
claims.scope: Large-margin numerical replay; independent interval/exact MATHCERT replay required before protected C05 adjudication text is changed.

claims.label: EXACT ALGEBRAIC SYMMETRY
claims.statement: Without imposing TE3, independent positive rescaling at each degree-one boundary factor can be compensated by inverse boundary-edge-weight rescaling, preserving all primitive edge increments and the prescribed embedding.

claims.label: EXACT RANK
claims.statement: The six boundary rescalings act with rank five on the five WP05 path quotient coordinates, have one-dimensional kernel generated by (1,-1,1,1,-1,-1), and act trivially on the three cycle coordinates.

claims.label: EXACT NONIDENTIFIABILITY
claims.statement: In the broader algebraic-realization class without TE3, primitive geometry determines only three quotient directions; five directions are genuinely non-identifiable.

claims.label: ANTI-CIRCULARITY
claims.statement: Identifying one of the five retained branches from geometry and then reading response-dependent algebraic boundary data is not a structural geometry-to-quotient inverse because all five branches were generated from one already-fixed quotient.

claims.label: C05 QUALIFICATION
claims.statement: Current evidence supports calling the retained objects planar algebraic Kenyon-Smirnov realizations with certified geometric properties. Calling them t-embeddings of the protected C04 weighted graph requires TE3 conformance not presently recorded.
claims.scope: Correction candidate pending independent MATHCERT replay.

claims.label: RESEARCH DISPOSITION
claims.statement: Terminal candidate is BOUNDARY_CALIBRATION_FIVE_DIMENSIONAL_OBSTRUCTION for the broader algebraic-realization class, together with full 8/8 geometry identifiability for any object that actually satisfies source TE3.

claims.label: CLAIM BOUNDARY
claims.statement: WP06 does not establish VGSE-C06, source correspondence, mechanics, rigid foldability, collision freedom, finite thickness, materials, manufacturability, product performance, patentability, or commercial value.
